named-native-query.name: CubridGetAttrs
named-native-query.query: SELECT A.CLASS_NAME AS objNm , B.ATTR_NAME AS attrNm , B.COMMENT AS attrNmKr , CASE WHEN B.DATA_TYPE = 'STRING' THEN 'VARCHAR' ELSE B.DATA_TYPE END AS dataType , B.PREC AS dataLen , B.SCALE AS dataDecimalLen , CASE WHEN B.IS_NULLABLE = 'YES' THEN 'Y' END AS nullableYn , CASE WHEN D.KEY_ATTR_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS pkYn , CASE WHEN F.KEY_ATTR_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS fkYn , B.DEFAULT_VALUE AS defaultVal , B.DEF_ORDER + 1 AS attrOrder FROM DB_CLASS A INNER JOIN DB_ATTRIBUTE B ON B.CLASS_NAME = A.CLASS_NAME LEFT JOIN DB_INDEX C ON C.IS_PRIMARY_KEY = 'YES' AND C.CLASS_NAME = B.CLASS_NAME LEFT JOIN DB_INDEX_KEY D ON D.CLASS_NAME = C.CLASS_NAME AND D.INDEX_NAME = C.INDEX_NAME AND D.KEY_ATTR_NAME = B.ATTR_NAME LEFT JOIN DB_INDEX E ON E.IS_FOREIGN_KEY = 'YES' AND E.CLASS_NAME = B.CLASS_NAME LEFT JOIN DB_INDEX_KEY F ON F.CLASS_NAME = E.CLASS_NAME AND F.INDEX_NAME = E.INDEX_NAME AND F.KEY_ATTR_NAME = B.ATTR_NAME WHERE A.is_system_class = 'NO' AND A.CLASS_TYPE = 'CLASS' AND UPPER(A.OWNER_NAME) = :owner GROUP BY objNm, attrNm ORDER BY objNm, attrOrder

named-native-query.name: CubridGetObjs
named-native-query.query: SELECT A.OWNER_NAME AS objOwner ,A.CLASS_NAME AS objNm ,A.COMMENT AS objNmkr ,count(B.ATTR_NAME) AS objAttrCnt ,'' AS objCretDt ,'' AS objUpdtDt ,'' AS tablespaceNm FROM DB_CLASS A, DB_ATTRIBUTE B WHERE A.CLASS_NAME = B.CLASS_NAME AND UPPER(A.OWNER_NAME) = :owner AND A.CLASS_TYPE = 'CLASS' AND A.is_system_class = 'NO' GROUP BY A.CLASS_NAME ORDER BY objOwner, objNm

named-native-query.name: OracleGetAttrs
named-native-query.query: SELECT A.TABLE_NAME AS objNm, A.COLUMN_NAME AS attrNm, A.COL_CMT AS attrNmKr, CASE WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'VARCHAR2' or A.DATA_TYPE = 'NVARCHAR' THEN 'VARCHAR' WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'NCHAR' THEN 'CHAR' WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'FLOAT' THEN 'NUMERIC' WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'NUMBER' THEN 'NUMERIC' WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'LONG' or A.DATA_TYPE = 'NCLOB' THEN 'CLOB' WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'BFILE' THEN 'BLOB' WHEN A.DATA_TYPE like 'TIMESTAMP%' THEN 'TIMESTAMP' ELSE A.DATA_TYPE END AS dataType, A.LEN AS dataLen, A.DATA_SCALE AS dataDecimalLen, A.NULLABLE AS nullableYn, B.POS AS pkYn, C.FK_POS fkYn, A.DATA_DEFAULT AS defaultVal, A.COLUMN_ID AS attrOrder FROM (SELECT S1.OWNER , S1.TABLE_NAME, S3.COMMENTS AS TAB_CMT, S1.COLUMN_NAME, S2.COMMENTS AS COL_CMT, S1.DATA_TYPE, CASE WHEN S1.DATA_PRECISION IS NOT NULL THEN DATA_PRECISION ELSE S1.DATA_LENGTH END AS LEN, DATA_SCALE, NULLABLE, COLUMN_ID, DATA_DEFAULT FROM ALL_TAB_COLUMNS S1, ALL_COL_COMMENTS S2, ALL_TAB_COMMENTS S3 WHERE S1.OWNER = S2.OWNER AND S1.TABLE_NAME = S2.TABLE_NAME AND S1.COLUMN_NAME = S2.COLUMN_NAME AND S1.OWNER = S3.OWNER AND S3.TABLE_TYPE = 'TABLE' AND S1.TABLE_NAME = S3.TABLE_NAME AND S1.TABLE_NAME IN (SELECT T.TABLE_NAME FROM ALL_TABLES T WHERE T.OWNER = S1.OWNER AND T.TABLESPACE_NAME NOT IN ('SYSTEM','SYSAUX')) AND S1.TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEMP%' ) A, (SELECT T1.OWNER, T1.TABLE_NAME, T2.COLUMN_NAME, 'Y' AS POS FROM (SELECT OWNER, TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_NAME FROM ALL_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'P' )T1, (SELECT OWNER, TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, POSITION FROM ALL_CONS_COLUMNS ) T2 WHERE T1.OWNER = T2.OWNER AND T1.TABLE_NAME = T2.TABLE_NAME AND T1.CONSTRAINT_NAME = T2.CONSTRAINT_NAME ) B, (SELECT DISTINCT T1.OWNER, T1.TABLE_NAME, T2.COLUMN_NAME, 'Y' AS FK_POS FROM (SELECT OWNER, TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_NAME FROM ALL_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'R' )T1, (SELECT OWNER, TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, POSITION FROM ALL_CONS_COLUMNS ) T2 WHERE T1.OWNER = T2.OWNER AND T1.TABLE_NAME = T2.TABLE_NAME AND T1.CONSTRAINT_NAME = T2.CONSTRAINT_NAME ) C WHERE A.OWNER = B.OWNER(+) AND A.TABLE_NAME = B.TABLE_NAME(+) AND A.COLUMN_NAME = B.COLUMN_NAME(+) AND A.OWNER = C.OWNER(+) AND A.TABLE_NAME = C.TABLE_NAME(+) AND A.COLUMN_NAME = C.COLUMN_NAME(+) AND UPPER(A.OWNER) = :owner ORDER BY objNm, attrOrder

named-native-query.name: OracleGetObjs
named-native-query.query: SELECT distinct S1.OWNER as objOwner --OWNER명 ,S1.TABLE_NAME as objNm --영문테이블명 ,S2.COMMENTS as objNmKr --한글테이블명 ,(SELECT count(COLUMN_NAME) FROM ALL_TAB_COLUMNS WHERE OWNER = S1.OWNER AND TABLE_NAME = S1.TABLE_NAME) as objAttrCnt --테이블컬럼개수 ,to_char(S3.CREATED,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') as objCretDt --등록일자 ,to_char(S3.LAST_DDL_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') as objUpdtDt --수정일자 ,S1.TABLESPACE_NAME as tablespaceNm --테이블스페이스 FROM ALL_TABLES S1 ,ALL_TAB_COMMENTS S2 ,ALL_OBJECTS S3 WHERE 1=1 AND S1.OWNER = S2.OWNER AND S1.TABLE_NAME = S2.TABLE_NAME AND S1.OWNER = S3.OWNER AND S1.TABLE_NAME = S3.OBJECT_NAME AND S2.TABLE_TYPE = 'TABLE' AND S3.OBJECT_TYPE = 'TABLE' AND S1.TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEMP%' AND S1.OWNER NOT IN ('SYS') AND S1.TABLESPACE_NAME NOT IN ('SYSTEM' , 'SYSAUX') AND UPPER(S1.OWNER) = :owner -- Owner명 입력 ORDER BY objOwner, objNm

named-native-query.name: OracleGetIndexes
named-native-query.query: SELECT I.OWNER AS objOwner, I.TABLE_NAME AS tableNm, I.INDEX_NAME AS indexNm, I.INDEX_TYPE AS indexType, I.UNIQUENESS AS uniqueness, IC.COLUMN_NAME AS columnNm, IC.COLUMN_POSITION AS columnPos, IC.DESCEND AS sortOrder, I.TABLESPACE_NAME AS tablespaceNm FROM ALL_INDEXES I JOIN ALL_IND_COLUMNS IC ON I.OWNER = IC.INDEX_OWNER AND I.INDEX_NAME = IC.INDEX_NAME WHERE UPPER(I.OWNER) = :owner AND I.TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEMP%' AND I.TABLE_NAME IN (SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM ALL_TABLES WHERE OWNER = I.OWNER AND TABLESPACE_NAME NOT IN ('SYSTEM','SYSAUX')) ORDER BY I.TABLE_NAME, I.INDEX_NAME, IC.COLUMN_POSITION

named-native-query.name: OracleGetConstraints
named-native-query.query: SELECT C.OWNER AS objOwner, C.TABLE_NAME AS tableNm, C.CONSTRAINT_NAME AS constraintNm, C.CONSTRAINT_TYPE AS constraintType, CC.COLUMN_NAME AS columnNm, CC.POSITION AS columnPos, R.OWNER AS refOwner, R.TABLE_NAME AS refTableNm, RC.COLUMN_NAME AS refColumnNm, C.DELETE_RULE AS deleteRule, C.STATUS AS status, C.SEARCH_CONDITION AS searchCondition FROM ALL_CONSTRAINTS C JOIN ALL_CONS_COLUMNS CC ON C.OWNER = CC.OWNER AND C.CONSTRAINT_NAME = CC.CONSTRAINT_NAME LEFT JOIN ALL_CONSTRAINTS R ON C.R_OWNER = R.OWNER AND C.R_CONSTRAINT_NAME = R.CONSTRAINT_NAME LEFT JOIN ALL_CONS_COLUMNS RC ON R.OWNER = RC.OWNER AND R.CONSTRAINT_NAME = RC.CONSTRAINT_NAME AND CC.POSITION = RC.POSITION WHERE UPPER(C.OWNER) = :owner AND C.CONSTRAINT_TYPE IN ('P', 'R', 'U', 'C') AND C.TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEMP%' AND C.TABLE_NAME IN (SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM ALL_TABLES WHERE OWNER = C.OWNER AND TABLESPACE_NAME NOT IN ('SYSTEM','SYSAUX')) ORDER BY C.TABLE_NAME, C.CONSTRAINT_TYPE, C.CONSTRAINT_NAME, CC.POSITION

named-native-query.name: MariaDBGetAttrs
named-native-query.query: SELECT t1.table_name AS objNm ,t2.column_name AS attrNm ,t2.column_comment AS attrNmKr ,CASE WHEN t2.is_nullable = 'YES' THEN 'Y' WHEN t2.is_nullable = 'NO' THEN 'N' END AS nullableYn ,t2.DATA_TYPE AS dataType ,CASE WHEN t2.NUMERIC_PRECISION is not null THEN t2.NUMERIC_PRECISION ELSE t2.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH END AS dataLen ,t2.NUMERIC_SCALE AS dataDecimalLen ,CASE WHEN t2.column_key = 'PRI' THEN 'Y' END AS pkYn ,CASE WHEN t2.FK_COLUMN is not null THEN 'Y' END AS fkYn ,t2.column_default AS defaultVal ,t2.ORDINAL_POSITION AS attrOrder FROM (SELECT table_schema, table_name, table_comment FROM information_schema.TABLES) t1, (SELECT table_schema, table_name, ORDINAL_POSITION, column_name, DATA_TYPE, column_key, (select column_name from information_schema.key_column_usage where table_schema = c1.table_schema and table_name = c1.table_name and referenced_table_name is not null) as FK_COLUMN, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, NUMERIC_PRECISION, NUMERIC_SCALE, is_nullable, column_default, column_comment FROM information_schema.COLUMNS c1) t2 WHERE upper(t1.TABLE_SCHEMA) = :owner AND t1.table_schema = t2.table_schema AND t1.table_name = t2.table_name ORDER BY objNm, attrOrder

named-native-query.name: MariaDBGetObjs
named-native-query.query: SELECT distinct S1.TABLE_SCHEMA as objOwner #OWNER명 , S1.TABLE_NAME as objNm #영문테이블명 , S1.TABLE_COMMENT as objNmKr #한글테이블명 , count(S2.COLUMN_NAME) over(partition by S1.TABLE_SCHEMA, S1.TABLE_NAME) as objAttrCnt #테이블컬럼개수 , to_char(S1.CREATE_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') as objCretDt #생성일자 , to_char(S1.UPDATE_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') as objUpdtDt #수정일자 , '' as tablespaceNm FROM information_schema.TABLES S1, information_schema.COLUMNS S2 WHERE S1.TABLE_SCHEMA = S2.TABLE_SCHEMA AND S1.TABLE_NAME = S2.TABLE_NAME AND upper(S1.TABLE_SCHEMA) = :owner AND TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE' ORDER BY objOwner, objNm

named-native-query.name: PostgreSQLGetObjs
named-native-query.query: SELECT n.nspname AS objOwner ,c.relname AS objNm ,obj_description(c.oid, 'pg_class') AS objNmKr ,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS objAttrCnt ,NULL AS objCretDt ,NULL AS objUpdtDt ,COALESCE(t.spcname, '') AS tablespaceNm FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_tablespace t ON t.oid = c.reltablespace WHERE c.relkind = 'r' AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pg_toast') AND lower(n.nspname) = lower(:owner) ORDER BY objOwner, objNm

named-native-query.name: PostgreSQLGetAttrs
named-native-query.query: SELECT c.relname AS objNm ,a.attname AS attrNm ,col_description(c.oid, a.attnum) AS attrNmKr ,CASE WHEN t.typname IN ('varchar','text','name') THEN 'VARCHAR' WHEN t.typname IN ('bpchar','char') THEN 'CHAR' WHEN t.typname IN ('int2','int4','int8','numeric','float4','float8') THEN 'NUMERIC' WHEN t.typname IN ('timestamp','timestamptz') THEN 'TIMESTAMP' WHEN t.typname = 'date' THEN 'DATE' WHEN t.typname IN ('bytea') THEN 'BLOB' ELSE upper(t.typname) END AS dataType ,CASE WHEN t.typname IN ('varchar','bpchar','char') AND a.atttypmod > 4 THEN a.atttypmod - 4 WHEN t.typname = 'numeric' AND a.atttypmod > 4 THEN ((a.atttypmod - 4) >> 16) & 65535 ELSE NULL END AS dataLen ,CASE WHEN t.typname = 'numeric' AND a.atttypmod > 4 THEN (a.atttypmod - 4) & 65535 ELSE NULL END AS dataDecimalLen ,CASE WHEN a.attnotnull THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS nullableYn ,CASE WHEN pk.attnum IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS pkYn ,CASE WHEN fk.attnum IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS fkYn ,pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid) AS defaultVal ,a.attnum AS attrOrder FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid AND c.relkind = 'r' JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = a.atttypid LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid = c.oid AND d.adnum = a.attnum LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT a.attnum FROM pg_constraint pc WHERE pc.conrelid = c.oid AND pc.contype = 'p' AND a.attnum = ANY(pc.conkey) LIMIT 1 ) pk ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT a.attnum FROM pg_constraint fc WHERE fc.conrelid = c.oid AND fc.contype = 'f' AND a.attnum = ANY(fc.conkey) LIMIT 1 ) fk ON TRUE WHERE a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pg_toast') AND lower(n.nspname) = lower(:owner) ORDER BY objNm, attrOrder

named-native-query.name: PostgreSQLGetIndexes
named-native-query.query: SELECT n.nspname AS objOwner ,t.relname AS tableNm ,i.relname AS indexNm ,am.amname AS indexType ,CASE WHEN ix.indisunique THEN 'UNIQUE' ELSE 'NONUNIQUE' END AS uniqueness ,a.attname AS columnNm ,k.ord AS columnPos ,CASE WHEN ix.indoption[k.ord - 1] & 1 = 1 THEN 'DESC' ELSE 'ASC' END AS sortOrder ,COALESCE(ts.spcname, '') AS tablespaceNm FROM pg_index ix JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = ix.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = ix.indrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = i.relam LEFT JOIN pg_tablespace ts ON ts.oid = i.reltablespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ix.indkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = t.oid AND a.attnum = k.attnum WHERE t.relkind = 'r' AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pg_toast') AND lower(n.nspname) = lower(:owner) ORDER BY tableNm, indexNm, columnPos

named-native-query.name: PostgreSQLGetConstraints
named-native-query.query: SELECT n.nspname AS objOwner ,t.relname AS tableNm ,c.conname AS constraintNm ,CASE c.contype WHEN 'p' THEN 'P' WHEN 'f' THEN 'R' WHEN 'u' THEN 'U' WHEN 'c' THEN 'C' END AS constraintType ,a.attname AS columnNm ,k.ord AS columnPos ,rn.nspname AS refOwner ,rt.relname AS refTableNm ,ra.attname AS refColumnNm ,CASE c.confdeltype WHEN 'a' THEN 'NO ACTION' WHEN 'r' THEN 'RESTRICT' WHEN 'c' THEN 'CASCADE' WHEN 'n' THEN 'SET NULL' WHEN 'd' THEN 'SET DEFAULT' END AS deleteRule ,CASE WHEN c.convalidated THEN 'ENABLED' ELSE 'DISABLED' END AS status ,pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) AS searchCondition FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = c.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = t.oid AND a.attnum = k.attnum LEFT JOIN pg_class rt ON rt.oid = c.confrelid LEFT JOIN pg_namespace rn ON rn.oid = rt.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attribute ra ON ra.attrelid = c.confrelid AND ra.attnum = c.confkey[k.ord] WHERE t.relkind = 'r' AND c.contype IN ('p','f','u','c') AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pg_toast') AND lower(n.nspname) = lower(:owner) ORDER BY tableNm, constraintType, constraintNm, columnPos
